programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Pearl Harbor'. Up until the end of 1941, the USA stayed resolutely neutral. Not surprisingly, there was little public appetite for joining a war that was taking place many miles away.

programme.title: Deadman's Curse
programme.desc: 'S2/E8 - The Unmarked Grave'. Could the source of Slumach's legendary lost gold actually be a lost Spanish mine east of the Pitt on Harrison Lake? Adam and Kru scour the Breakenridge landslide for evidence.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E5 of 18 - On The Road: American Champion'. After three gruelling challenges, which smith will come out on top, becoming the first ever Forged in Fire: On the Road champion?

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E6 of 18 - Chef's Special'. Four smiths are tasked with forging a chef's knife. After a round of testing performed by a chef, only two head back to their home forge to build a brutal hog splitter.

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: 'S19/E11 - Searching In Selma'. Mike and Jersey uncover a massive collection of petroliana in Alabama while Dani and Robbie hit an Arizona property with killer steam engines as far as the eye can see.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S16/E3 of 10 - Weathering Sights'. It's a cold day in Banning, as Laura tries to comfort the buyers with hot cocoa and umbrellas. Brandi changes her plans for a chance at a big win. Kenny risks his money on a file cabinet.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S11/E2 - Whiskers and Lies'. In Hawaiian Gardens, Darrell breaks in the new guy. Brandi and Jarrod detect something mysterious in their unit, Justin paws his way through a decent locker.

programme.title: Storage Hunters
programme.desc: 'S3/E13'. Sean auctions off four massive hangers filled with potential treasures. Jesse and T Money go head to head with Mone and Team Brandori to snag the ultimate prize. How far will they go to win?

programme.title: Storage Hunters
programme.desc: 'S4/E1 - Mystery Trailer'. Sean tows a mysterious trailer to the auction and everyone wonders what's inside. T Money and Papa Bear battle over bins while Brandon and Lori play different kinds of games.

programme.title: Canadian Pickers
programme.desc: 'S1/E11 - Rocking On'. The guys are picking their way through Ontario and think they've hit the jackpot: their first stop is a sprawling property with so many outbuildings it could double as a village.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Bombing The Reich'. During the early years of the war, Britain and her allies were almost powerless to hit back at Germany. They were on the back foot, unable to take the war to where the Germans would feel it most.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Road To Burma'. The expansion of the Japanese empire had as its main aim the conquest of territories rich in natural resources. And so Japan cast its eyes towards South East Asia.

programme.title: Secrets In The Ice

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Ramen Japan
programme.desc: Great ramen is found along Route 8 - enjoy Hokuriku's local ramen born and raised with the rise of Japan's car culture!

programme.title: Core Kyoto Mini
programme.desc: The head Inari shrine has 30,000 subordinate shrines throughout Japan - since its foundation in 711 A.D. / C.E., the Inari deities have attracted worshippers with varying needs.

programme.title: Easy Japanese For Work
programme.desc: Today: making a polite request to a superior. Jorge Andres Arevalos Ibarra from Paraguay works at a metalworking company - in a role play challenge, he makes a polite request to a higher-up.

programme.title: Zero Waste Life
programme.desc: Papermaker Igarashi Masami's 'Food Paper' is based on historic Echizen washi and incorporates vegetable discards and scraps - her aim is to raise awareness of food loss and promote traditional crafts.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Somewhere Street
programme.desc: Philadelphia, the City of Brotherly Love, is the US East Coast's second-largest city after NYC - it's the birthplace of the US and was once the capital, and it's now a favourite for history buffs.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Chatroom Japan
programme.desc: Kang Sang-mi, a third-generation Korean born and raised in Japan, embraced her Korean name and heritage after struggling with her identity - she now empowers kids with foreign roots.

programme.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change The World
programme.desc: Food waste is a major driver of global warming - one institute warns that greenhouse gas emissions from food waste exceed those of nations like India and Russia. We examine the data behind this issue.

programme.title: Clothing That Protects
programme.desc: Fashion designer Morinaga Kunihiko visits Amami Oshima in Kagoshima - priestesses on Amami wore patchwork robes with triangular butterfly designs intended to protect the wearer from unseen spirits.

programme.title: Where We Call Home
programme.desc: This time we meet Senegalese Serigne Cisse - who works as a taxi driver in Fukuoka City - and Filipino Sharon Mochiyama, a kimono instructor and dresser in Matsumoto in Nagano Prefecture.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Kaizoku
programme.desc: The Murakami Kaizoku were seafarers and fighters in the Seto Inland Sea - we explore their history and legacy with footage from time-lapse creator Shimizu Daisuke. This time: Nii Oshima Island.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Solar Flares: The sun's tremendous energy provides various benefits but also poses some significant risks - we explore the mysteries of solar flares and their threat to human activities.

programme.title: Activate Your Japanese
programme.desc: Learn how to make the most of your Japanese skills - watch our drama that features useful communication strategies, our snappy videos about onomatopoeia, and our documentaries on 'senpai' in Japan.

programme.title: Culture Crossroads
programme.desc: Hana no Kai is an elderly daycare facility in Kobe that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds - it makes the lives of those living out their final years in a foreign land more active and dignified.

programme.title: Hello! NHK World-Japan
